senzu.limitations: Inherited median across small 22–34 px subjects; expected uncertainty about 3–5%. No original black-and-white close-up available.

renderReview.renderer: ImageMagick, forced TORIYAMA_RASTER=magick; no browser automation
renderReview.sphereFinding: Clear sphere and single star at 32 px and above. At 16 px the red centre remains but star points merge; do not use to encode exact star count at this size.
renderReview.senzuFinding: Oval, cap and short hilum visible at 32 px and above. At 16 px hilum merges into the darker end; silhouette remains distinct. Outline loses contrast on dark background; green fill carries shape.
